{{Otheruses|Imperial Complex}}
The '''Imperial Complex''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Najarka]] consisted of an [[IM-455 modular garrison|Imperial garrison base]], with several outbuildings connected by [[allacrete]] walkways. One of the buildings was the [[Imperial Biological Research Center]]. The Complex was abandoned sometime before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] as the native wildlife kept eating the base's [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]].
